requirements.check_policy: Require the complete named set with no false rows or qualification substitutions. The default-No observation intentionally executes twice, once before No and once before explicit Yes; do not enforce globally unique emitted rows.

review.scope: Actual host/menu/CommandSpec/current controller/fixture builder/transport/Job fields; active owned native/modal cleanup; fixture contexts retained through real host Close/executor and child cleanup; restored before final source checks.

source_notes: No product registry/provider or worker replacement. The four temporary observers/fixtures forward current host/controller/Job behavior and are retained through actual cleanup.

Only explicit local file-picker choices and the inert synthetic interpreter marker are substituted. No user voice/model/private assets.
